title: Coherent signed integer shifts of totalized additive bifunctors
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and suppose $\mathcal D$ has countable coproducts. Let $T:\mathcal A\times\mathcal B\to\mathcal D$ be additive in each variable. For integer-indexed cochain complexes $P,Q$, with the shift convention of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $T^\bullet(P,Q)^r=\bigoplus_{p+q=r}T(P^p,Q^q)$ with differential $T(d_P,1)+(-1)^pT(1,d_Q)$. There are natural chain isomorphisms $s^1_n:T^\bullet(P[n],Q)\cong T^\bullet(P,Q)[n]$ and $s^2_n:T^\bullet(P,Q[n])\cong T^\bullet(P,Q)[n]$, for every $n\in\mathbf Z$. The first is unsigned on each summand; the second multiplies the summand whose first-factor degree is $p$ by $(-1)^{np}$. For each fixed argument these comparisons satisfy the zero-shift and addition-of-shifts laws. Chain maps in the fixed argument induce natural transformations commuting with the comparisons in the varying argument. The two orders of extracting shifts $a,b$ in the two arguments differ by $(-1)^{ab}$, after the canonical identification of the two total shifts. These data constitute the canonical integer bifunctor shift structure.
